design.bodies: one per task point, all y=45, v=(3,0), lockstep (no collisions)

finding: identifiability depends on the observer's self-model: a wrong occluder model can move the blind spot onto the events and lose 3 of 4. Cost tracks which wrong motion is chosen (the ranking flip), not the error magnitude: |delta|=10 costs 3, |delta|=20 costs 2
falsified: P3 — no tested delta was free, so 'some self-model errors cost nothing' is wrong in this grid

boundary_exclusion.rule: R-P1.12 standing boundary rule (1e-6), same 1e-13 accumulation artifact as R-P1.11
